name: Etam
overview: Etam appears in Scripture as a significant location connected to the story of Samson. It is described as a rock where Samson dwelt after a victorious battle and where he was later bound by men of Judah to be delivered to the Philistines. These events highlight Etam as both a place of refuge and conflict during Samson's struggles, emphasizing the tension between Israel and the Philistines as well as internal challenges within Judah.
